findings.location: Risks and sensitive actions — Security review
findings.problem: The plan says a security review runs only if the owner asks, but the project policy requires asking the owner whether to run one when a change touches a subprocess or network boundary. This change adds owner-configured text that is forwarded to the embedding bridge and adds a checked field to the vector file.
findings.suggestion: Add an explicit pre-implementation security-review checkpoint that asks the owner whether to review this config-to-bridge/vector-file surface and records the response.

summary: The plan is otherwise aligned with the named specs; it needs the required security-review decision checkpoint.
